listing.description: A website for a designer furniture bureau: a project index with huge numbers, services with a dimension line under the price, stages on level marks and a drafting grid.

seo.title: Forma Studio — bespoke designer furniture in Tashkent
seo.description: Architects design furniture for your interior: built-in storage, kitchens, tables and shelving. Drawings in 5 days, production from 30 days.
seo.answer: Forma Studio is a furniture architecture bureau in Tashkent (16 Shakhrisabz St). We design and make built-in and cabinet furniture to bespoke drawings: drawings in 5 working days from 1,500,000 UZS, production from 30 days, installation in 1–3 days.

sections.title: Furniture as part of architecture
sections.subtitle: We design wardrobes, kitchens, libraries and tables as precisely as buildings: with drawings, joints and millimetre tolerances.

sections.label: Bureau
sections.title: Drawing first, timber second
sections.text: There are eight of us: three architects, a design engineer and four makers in our own workshop in Sergeli. Every piece starts with a measured plan of the flat and ends with an installation led by the same architect. We work with oak, ash, veneer and HPL laminate; hardware is Blum and Hettich.

items.title: Built-in storage
items.text: Floor-to-ceiling wardrobes, walk-in closets, appliance niches — no gaps, no visible joints.

items.title: Kitchens
items.text: From working-triangle ergonomics to sockets in the splashback. Oak veneer or matt laminate fronts.

items.title: Tables and libraries
items.text: Solid-wood dining tables, book walls and workstations with cable channels.

items.title: Design only
items.text: Drawings and a specification any workshop can build from.

items.title: A library in Mirabad
items.text: An ash book wall for 1,400 volumes with a rail ladder · Length: 7.2 m · Lead time: 38 days · Material: ash

items.title: An island kitchen in Yunusabad
items.text: A 3.4 m island with a hob and a hidden extractor · Length: 6.8 m · Lead time: 44 days · Material: oak veneer

items.title: An IT company office
items.text: Twenty workstations, a meeting room and a coffee point in one system · Area: 240 m² · Lead time: 52 days · Material: HPL

items.title: Survey
items.text: Laser survey of the room and photos of the joints.

items.title: Sketch and quote
items.text: Two options with prices — in 3 days.

items.title: Working drawings
items.text: Joints, cutting plans, hardware — we agree every sheet.

items.title: Production
items.text: In our own workshop, with a photo report every week.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We install, adjust and clean up after ourselves.

items.q: Can I order just the design?
items.a: Yes, drawings and a specification from 1,500,000 UZS that any workshop can build from.
50% after drawings are approved, 40% before delivery, 10% after installation.
Yes, across Uzbekistan; delivery and installers’ travel are quoted separately.
Two years on the furniture and lifetime on Blum hardware.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Send us your floor plan
sections.text: We reply within a day with lead times. Bureau: 16 Shakhrisabz St, Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00.
